probe_capture.purpose: prove which node the agy CLI probe actually uses
probe_capture.snippet: GET /connections every 1s for 12s while the CLI runs; keep only rows whose host matches googleapis/cloudcode
probe_capture.caveat: metadata.process is EMPTY (TUN) -> cannot filter by PID; rely on time window + host + rulePayload
probe_capture.degraded: if nothing is captured (short-lived gRPC streams): fall back to rule index + group.now snapshot and label it INFERRED

risks: store-selected:true -> every PUT is PERSISTED in cache.db; an interrupted script leaves Google pinned to the test node even after Clash restart. ALWAYS run restore + verify.
Google group is shared by ALL googleapis traffic of every local session (plugin, agy, browser, oauth). Switching it re-routes other live sessions mid-flight.
日本节点 URLTest group contains a Nigeria node (filter bug) -> never assume "日本节点" == Japan.
香港节点 contains a type=direct member (直连) -> selecting it bypasses the proxy entirely.
地方组 (美国节点/日本节点/...) are URLTest/Fallback/LoadBalance -> NOT directly pin-able; they auto-reselect. Pin the PARENT Selector (Google / 漏网之鱼) instead.
All 59 nodes share entry host g2.devoodev.com -> exit country is only provable by measurement.
No listeners: section -> no zero-collateral per-node measurement port.
Do NOT switch mode=global: it would re-route ALL local traffic incl. Tailscale DERP/SSH/other sessions.

redaction.method: token-shape scan over three OAuth families: access-token prefix, authorization-code prefix, JWT-header base64 prefix
redaction.applied_masking: mihomo API secret -> $SECRET / ***  ; inbound proxy password -> $CLASH_AUTH / ***
redaction.note: the three literal prefixes are intentionally NOT spelled out inside these artifacts, so that the scan itself stays at 0 hits (a spelled-out pattern would self-match). Run the scan from the runbook/parent side.

chain_order: artifacts list OUTERMOST-FIRST (rule-target group -> ... -> final node). mihomo GET /connections reports the REVERSE order (final node first).
snapshot_note: URLTest groups (美国节点/日本节点/其它地区/延迟最低/故障转移) auto-reselect: their "now" drifted during this recon (美国节点: V1|06 -> V1|02). Any "now" is a point-in-time snapshot, always re-read before acting.
